title: Fire Emergency Response
content: In case of fire, alert others immediately and evacuate the building using the stairs, never the elevator. If there is heavy smoke, crawl low to the ground where the air is cleaner. Feel doors with the back of your hand before opening; if a door is hot, do not open it. Find an alternate escape route. Once outside, go to your designated meeting place and call the fire department. Never re-enter a burning building.
